about: One agent answers a question with a single known answer: is Canberra the capital of Australia? It runs on Anthropic Fast.
how: A chain of one agent. The run has one step.
learns: For a simple question one agent is enough: here it takes about 1 second and 140 tokens in all.
watch: The very small numbers in Statistics: 81 input tokens, 62 output tokens, one step. Compare with the debate of the same question.
